# apple_clear_sandbox_purchase_history (Action)

Clears the purchase history of sandbox testers, so they can buy non-consumables and subscriptions again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_clear_sandbox_purchase_history" "ann" {
  config {
    sandbox_tester_ids = [apple_sandbox_tester.ann.id]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sandbox_tester_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the sandbox testers.
